questions.answer: The document clearly outlines the need for action on climate change. It acknowledges the unequivocal warming of the climate system, as evidenced by increases in global average air and ocean temperatures, widespread melting of snow and ice, and rising average sea level. It also recognizes that this warming has occurred as a result of human activities. The document further emphasizes that adaptation will be necessary to address impacts resulting from the warming which is already unavoidable due to past emissions. It asserts that there is no alternative but to undertake adaptation planning, even in an environment of extensive mitigation. The document also provides recommendations for raising awareness of climate change risks, incorporating adaptation strategies into strategic management planning, including climate change risk management results into the Council’s risk management database, and monitoring and reviewing risk management context to identify new climate change risks and reanalyse all existing risks.
